document: NASA-TM-81232, Caradonna and Tung (1981), experiment description printed page 2 and Figure 4
purpose: Low-Mach hover collective comparison only; not torque, wake distribution, forward flight or whole-aircraft validation
tolerance_rationale: Predeclared before comparison: conceptual uniform-inflow rigid rotor may differ by up to one degree; this is a screening criterion, not a measurement uncertainty
limitations: Dimensionless hover similarity uses normalized radius, not a reconstructed test rotor size. Half-degree experimental precone is neglected. No Reynolds-dependent airfoil data, tip loss, nonuniform wake or compressibility correction. No coefficients tuned to this case.
